usual_adult_dose.indication: Respiratory tract and soft tissue (40 kg or more)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 250 to 500 mg IV or IM every 6 hours

usual_adult_dose.indication: Gastrointestinal and genitourinary (40 kg or more)

usual_adult_dose.dose: 150 to 200 mg/kg/day divided every 3 to 4 hours
Two 500 mg doses 8 to 12 hours apart

key_interactions.effect: More skin rash with ampicillin-class drugs (label).
